contract.displayName: Libra Product Identity Selection Intent Commit
contract.atomicFactSet: authenticated manual choice + current Libra Run/Subject/Identity head fence + immutable `libra_product_identity_selection_intents` row + Command Receipt；该Admin command不伪造Event Result或commit marker；选择只允许后端给出的candidate或typed TMDB ID：Movie为tmdbMovieId，Series为tmdbSeriesId，两者互斥；Series namespace为tmdb_series，Season只从同Run冻结Candidate Season Claim读取，必须匹配当前Subject Profile及Run execution basis，用户不能改季或扩集；Series请求摘要纳入该Season与executionBasisDigest，后续provider_exact继续核验TV及该Season，不能直接发布Identity；`hasOutbox=false`
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: Owner业务修改后响应前崩溃、相同key同payload重试、相同key不同payload重试
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: Receipt与Owner修改同事务；同payload返回原result ref；不同payload稳定拒绝；不重复创建对象或推进revision
